name: Vorota Pro
tagline: Gates and fences that open with one button and last for decades
niche: Wrought gates, fences and automation for private homes

listing.description: A website for a maker of gates, fences and automation. A drawing of a sliding gate that opens as you scroll, a catalogue of fence sections priced per running metre and a “model × length” calculator right on the page.

seo.title: Vorota Pro — gates and fences in Tashkent with automation
seo.description: Wrought and sliding gates, louvre, corrugated-sheet and 3D-mesh fences, turnkey automation. From 290,000 UZS per running metre, free measuring, installation from 7 days.
seo.answer: Vorota Pro makes gates and fences in Tashkent, with a workshop and showroom at 38 Fargona Yuli St.; open Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00 and Saturday 10:00–16:00. A 3D-mesh fence starts at 290,000 UZS, a wrought fence with spears at 650,000 UZS, louvres at 780,000 UZS per running metre; sliding gate automation starts at 4,800,000 UZS. Measuring is free, installation takes from 7 days, with a 3-year warranty.

sections.title: Gates that open themselves
sections.subtitle: We design, weld and install gates and fences for private homes. Our own workshop on Fargona Yuli — prices per running metre with no middlemen.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: Sections and prices per metre
sections.intro: Prices are for 1.8 m height including posts and paint. Pick a model and length in the calculator below to see the total straight away.

items.title: Measuring
items.text: A specialist brings samples and measures the opening, the ground and the drive position.

items.text: We concrete the posts, fit the sections and drive, and show you how to use the remote.

items.author: School management

items.q: How much does a fence cost per metre?
items.a: From 290,000 UZS per running metre for 3D mesh to 1,200,000 UZS for ornamental forging. The price includes posts, paint and installation at 1.8 m height.
Fences and sliding gates take from 7 days after measuring; ornamental forging takes from 3 weeks.
Nice and BFT drives with the manufacturer’s warranty. A sliding gate kit starts at 4,800,000 UZS including installation and setup.
Yes, measuring within Tashkent is free with no obligation. In the region it is free for orders of 30 running metres or more.
3 years on the structure and paint; automation carries the manufacturer’s warranty plus a year of our service.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Visit the showroom
sections.text: Samples of every section and working drives are on display at the Fargona Yuli showroom. Or leave a request and a measurer will come on a day that suits you.
